requirements.summary: Roll back frontend runtime behavior to match Draft Version 8 UI flows, caching, and authorization gating behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: After rebuild and deploy, the app’s UI flows and data/authorization behavior match the Draft Version 8 behavior as the user experienced it.
No new regressions are introduced in sign-in/sign-out flow, records CRUD (admin + personal), and admin gating versus the Version 8 baseline.
The deployed draft can be opened and used without runtime errors in the browser console.

file_operations.description: Restore Version 8-like identity-scoped data fetching behavior by scoping the personal record React Query cache key to the signed-in principal (prevent cross-user cache leakage after logout/login) and ensure the loading/fetched flags remain consistent with actor/identity readiness. Use the authorization component patterns (Internet Identity gating expectations) and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align admin-record mutations to the same identity-scoped query keys used by admin record queries (avoid stale UI and mismatched cache updates), and ensure optimistic updates/invalidation target the correct cache entries for the current principal. Continue using blob-storage ExternalBlob upload support for images and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure admin record list queries use the same query key conventions expected by mutations and view wiring (identity-scoped), and confirm Version 8-like behavior for refresh/refetch when identity changes. Use the authorization component patterns for admin-only data visibility and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Restore Version 8 admin CRUD interaction behavior by ensuring create/update/delete flows use stable record identifiers, selection behavior updates reliably after mutations, and the admin records list refreshes correctly using the identity-scoped caches. Ensure admin gating remains consistent with authorization expectations and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Restore Version 8 sign-out behavior by clearing all identity-scoped caches (including personal record cache) and any admin/personal record caches keyed by principal to avoid post-logout data bleed and UI inconsistencies. Use the authorization component sign-in/sign-out guidance and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Validate and restore Version 8 admin gating UX and state transitions (initializing → sign-in prompt → verifying access → access denied/allowed) and ensure errors from authorization checks are handled without console/runtime crashes. Use the authorization component access control UI guidance and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Restore Version 8 top-level navigation and view switching behavior by ensuring admin view access is only exposed when the current principal is confirmed admin, and the app safely returns to the records view on auth/role changes without leaving the UI in an inconsistent state. Use the authorization component patterns and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
